column1: # TerrainGrid batch: owner | M | old | descriptor | semantic name
# Derived from the bodies: c[] is the per-corner "land" flag (true = land), so g() = all four
# corners land, h() = no corner land, i() = coast (mixed), and the domain entry rules read
# deliberately as: Ground needs not-water, Water needs not-all-land, Amphibian only needs
# an unblocked cell. i[]/j[] are the per-domain adjusted centres precomputed in buildTerrain.
# Descriptors come from javap - do not edit them.
